Keysight Technologies Inc closed the quarter ended 2026-07-31 with revenue of 1.85 billion, up 36.54 percent from a year earlier, and net income of 397 million, up 107.85 percent, on a net margin of 21.51 percent [D1]. Communications Solutions Group revenue of 1.35 billion rose 43.09 percent and Electronic Industrial Solutions Group revenue of 501 million rose 21.60 percent, so the growth was broad rather than single-product [D1]. For the fourth quarter the company guided revenue to 1.93 billion to 1.95 billion, about 37 percent growth at the midpoint, and earnings per share of 3.34 to 3.40 on 172 million diluted shares [D1].

What the market is arguing about is durability rather than the quarter itself, and the tell is that earnings per share of 2.82 against an estimate of 2.16, a surprise of 30.56 percent on the report dated 2026-08-18, was followed in the session dated 2026-08-19 by a move of -6.32 percent [D2]. Management gave the skeptics material, saying supply chain will remain the governor of near-term revenue, that the supply environment is less flexible than a year ago, and that demand is not the limiter [D3]. Management also cautioned that the one-time tariff impacts that lifted fiscal 2026 profitability will not repeat, which raises the comparison bar for every quarter that follows [D4]. Where the two sides meet is valuation: the shares carry a trailing price to earnings of 45.89 but a forward price to earnings of 20.66 on trailing earnings per share of 7.38, so the argument is whether the forward figure or the trailing figure describes the business [D5].

The plan is therefore to stay with the position while the reported evidence holds and to let three checks govern the size of it [D3]. The first is revenue at or above 1.93 billion, the bottom of the guided range, since anything below that would confirm supply rather than demand as the binding constraint [D3]. The second is gross margin holding at or above 65.87 percent, because a lower figure would confirm the tariff benefit is fading rather than the mix improving [D1]. The third is segment operating income growth staying above 81.36 percent, since slower growth there would show costs outrunning the revenue they support [D1].

On price the stock closed at 333.42, above the 20-day average of 330.47, the 50-day average of 326.21 and the 200-day average of 289.31, with the trend state listed as uptrend and the 14-day relative strength index at 54.21 [D2]. The immediate support band of 332.78 to 300.87, marked at strength 59, is the level that would end that uptrend, while resistance sits at 366.41 [D2]. Beyond the price, management will be at the Goldman Sachs Communacopia + Technology Conference on 2026-09-11 and the 2026 Truist Technology Symposium on 2026-09-15, and the automotive AI safety work with the Centre for Assuring Autonomy at the University of York is the sort of funded development that supports the longer cycle [D6].
